	function v_u_13.bag() -- name: bag
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_26
		local v_u_370 = {}

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_371, (ref) v_u_370, (ref) v_u_26, (ref) v_u_372

					local v377 = v_u_370

					local v379 = v_u_370[v374]
					v376[v374] = v378
					v377[v375] = v379
				end

					local v380 = v_u_370
					local v381 = v_u_370
					local v382 = v_u_370[2]

	end

	local v85 = v83 * (p81 or 1) / v_u_2.SHINY_ODDS
	local v86 = p79:NextNumber()
	return v86 < v84 and "Rainbow" or (v86 < v84 + v85 and "Shiny" or nil)
end

function v_u_2.power(p102, p103) -- name: power

	end

		p103 = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

	local v105 = v104.share

	local v107 = v_u_2.POWER.Common

function v_u_2.secretLuck(p113) -- name: secretLuck

	local v115 = math.max(v114, 0)
	local v116 = (p113:GetAttribute("PotionSecretLuck") or 1) - 1
	local v117 = v115 + math.max(v116, 0)
	local v118 = (p113:GetAttribute("Echo2SecretLuck") or 1) - 1
	local v119 = math.max(v118, 0)
	local v120 = v117 + math.min(v119, 0.35)
	local v121 = p113:GetAttribute("TreeSecretLuck") or 0
	local v122 = v120 + math.clamp(v121, 0, 0.15) + v_u_2.eggMilestone(p113, "SecretLuck")
	local v123 = (p113:GetAttribute("MerchSecretLuck") or 1) - 1
	local v124 = math.max(v123, 0)

	return (p113:GetAttribute("Pass_SecretHunter") == true and 2 or 1) * (math.min(v125, 0.9) + 1)
end
function v_u_2.chances(p126, p127, p128) -- name: chances
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v129 = v_u_2.EGGS[p126]
	if v129.exclusive then
		p127 = 1
		p128 = 1
	end
	local v130 = 0
	local v131 = 0
	local v132 = 0
	local v133 = {}
	for _, v134 in ipairs(v129.pets) do
		v130 = v130 + v134.weight
		if v_u_2.PETS[v134.id].rarity == "Secret" then
			continue
		end
		local v135 = p127 or 1
		local v136 = v_u_2.PETS[v134.id]
		local v137
		if v136.rarity == "Secret" then
			v137 = v134.weight * 1
		else
			v137 = v134.weight * (v_u_2.RARITY[v136.rarity].order >= 3 and v135 and v135 or 1)
		end
		v131 = v131 + v137
	end
	for _, v138 in ipairs(v129.pets) do
		if v_u_2.PETS[v138.id].rarity ~= "Secret" then
			continue
		end
		v132 = v132 + v138.weight * (p128 or 1) / v130
	end
	for _, v139 in ipairs(v129.pets) do
		local v140
		if v_u_2.PETS[v139.id].rarity == "Secret" then
			v140 = v139.weight * (p128 or 1) / v130
		else
			local v141 = p127 or 1
			local v142 = v_u_2.PETS[v139.id]
			local v143
			if v142.rarity == "Secret" then
				v143 = v139.weight * 1
			else
				v143 = v139.weight * (v_u_2.RARITY[v142.rarity].order >= 3 and v141 and v141 or 1)
			end
			v140 = v143 / v131 * (1 - v132)
		end
		local v144 = {
			["id"] = v139.id,
			["chance"] = v140,
			["odds"] = 1 / v140
		}
		table.insert(v133, v144)
	end
	return v133
end
function v_u_2.roll(p145, p146, p147, p148) -- name: roll

	local v149 = p147:NextNumber()
	for _, v150 in ipairs(v_u_2.chances(p145, p146, p148)) do
		v149 = v149 - v150.chance
		if v149 > 0 then
			continue
		end
		return v150.id
	end
	return v_u_2.EGGS[p145].pets[1].id
end

	local v158 = v_u_2.MAX_SLOTS
	return math.min(v157, v158)
end

	end

function v_u_2.equippedList(p_u_170) -- name: equippedList
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v171 = {}
	for v172 in pairs(v_u_2.PETS) do
		for _ = 1, v_u_2.equipped(p_u_170, v172) do
			table.insert(v171, v172)
		end
	end
	table.sort(v171, function(p173, p174)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2, (copy) p_u_170
		local v175 = v_u_2.power(p173, p_u_170)
		local v176 = v_u_2.power(p174, p_u_170)
		if v175 == v176 then
			return p173 < p174
		else
			return v176 < v175
		end
	end)
	return v171
end

	return v178
end
function v_u_2.bucksMult(p180) -- name: bucksMult
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v181 = 1
	for v182 in pairs(v_u_2.PETS) do
		local v183 = v_u_2.equipped(p180, v182)
		if v183 <= 0 then
			continue
		end
		v181 = v181 + v_u_2.power(v182, p180) * v183
	end
	return v181
end
function v_u_2.found(p184, p185) -- name: found
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	if v_u_2.owned(p184, p185) > 0 then
		return true
	end
	local v186 = p184:GetAttribute("PetFound_" .. p185)
	local v187
	if v186 == true then
		v187 = true
	elseif type(v186) == "number" then
		v187 = v186 > 0
	else
		v187 = false
	end
	return v187
end

function v_u_2.rewardLines(p210) -- name: rewardLines
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_209, (copy) v_u_2
	local v211 = {}
	for _, v212 in ipairs({
		"bucks",
		"luck",
		"speed",
		"shiny",
		"rainbow",
		"bonus"
	}) do
		if not p210[v212] then
			continue
		end
		local v213 = {
			["key"] = v212
		}
		local v214 = p210[v212] * 100 + 0.5
		v213.text = "+" .. math.floor(v214) .. "% " .. v_u_209[v212]
		v213.color = v_u_2.REWARD_COLOR[v212]
		table.insert(v211, v213)
	end
	if p210.slots then
		local v215 = {
			["key"] = "slots",
			["text"] = nil,
			["color"] = nil,
			["text"] = "+" .. p210.slots .. " Pet Slot" .. (p210.slots == 1 and "" or "s"),
			["color"] = v_u_2.REWARD_COLOR.slots
		}
		table.insert(v211, v215)
	end
	if p210.extra then
		local v216 = {
			["key"] = "extra",
			["text"] = nil,
			["color"] = nil,
			["text"] = "+" .. p210.extra .. " Egg per Hatch",
			["color"] = v_u_2.REWARD_COLOR.extra
		}
		table.insert(v211, v216)
	end
	return v211
end
function v_u_2.eggSecrets(p217) -- name: eggSecrets
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v218 = {}
	for _, v219 in ipairs(v_u_2.EGGS[p217].pets) do
		if v_u_2.PETS[v219.id].rarity ~= "Secret" then
			continue
		end
		local v220 = v219.id
		table.insert(v218, v220)
	end
	return v218
end
function v_u_2.eggProgress(p221, p222, p223) -- name: eggProgress
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v224 = v_u_2.EGGS[p222]
	local v225 = 0
	local v226 = 0
	for _, v227 in ipairs(v224.pets) do
		if v_u_2.PETS[v227.id].rarity == "Secret" then
			continue
		end
		v225 = v225 + 1
		if not v_u_2.found(p221, v227.id .. (p223 or "")) then
			continue
		end
		v226 = v226 + 1
	end
	return v226, v225, v225 <= v226
end
function v_u_2.discovered(p228, p229) -- name: discovered
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v230 = 0
	local v231 = 0
	for _, v232 in ipairs(v_u_2.AREAS) do
		if p229 and v232.id ~= p229 then
			continue
		end
		for _, v233 in ipairs(v232.eggs) do
			for _, v234 in ipairs(v_u_2.EGGS[v233].pets) do
				v230 = v230 + 1
				if not v_u_2.found(p228, v234.id) then
					continue
				end
				v231 = v231 + 1
			end
		end
	end
	return v231, v230
end
function v_u_2.indexBonus(p235) -- name: indexBonus
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v236 = {
		["bucks"] = 0,
		["luck"] = 0,
		["speed"] = 0,
		["shiny"] = 0,
		["rainbow"] = 0,
		["slots"] = 0,
		["extra"] = 0,
		["bonus"] = 0
	}
	for v237, v238 in pairs(v_u_2.INDEX_TABS) do
		local v239 = v_u_2.SUFFIX[v237]
		for v240, v241 in pairs(v238.eggs) do
			local _, _, v242 = v_u_2.eggProgress(p235, v240, v239)
			if not v242 then
				continue
			end
			for v243 in pairs(v236) do
				v236[v243] = v236[v243] + (v241[v243] or 0)
			end
		end
		for v244, v245 in pairs(v238.secrets or {}) do
			local v246 = true
			for _, v247 in ipairs(v_u_2.eggSecrets(v244)) do
				if v_u_2.found(p235, v247 .. v239) then
					continue
				end
				v246 = false
			end
			if not v246 then
				break
			end
			for v248 in pairs(v236) do
				v236[v248] = v236[v248] + (v245[v248] or 0)
			end
		end
	end
	local v249 = v_u_2.discovered(p235)
	for _, v250 in ipairs(v_u_2.INDEX_MILESTONES) do
		if v250.n > v249 then
			continue
		end
		for v251 in pairs(v236) do
			v236[v251] = v236[v251] + (v250[v251] or 0)
		end
	end
	return 1 + v236.bucks, 1 + v236.luck, 1 + v236.speed, 1 + v236.shiny, 1 + v236.rainbow, v236.slots, v236.extra, v236.bonus
end
function v_u_2.eggMilestone(p252, p253) -- name: eggMilestone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v254 = nil
	for _, v255 in ipairs(v_u_1.Milestones or {}) do
		if v255.id ~= "Eggs" then
			continue
		end
		v254 = v255
	end
	if not v254 then
		return 0
	end
	local v256 = 0
	for v257 = 1, v_u_1.MilestoneLevel(v254, p252:GetAttribute("MS_Eggs") or 0) do
		for _, v258 in ipairs(v254.bonuses[v257]) do
			if v258.stat ~= p253 then
				continue
			end
			v256 = v256 + v258.amount
		end
	end
	return v256
end
function v_u_2.hatchSpeed(p259) -- name: hatchSpeed
	return p259:GetAttribute("HatchSpeed") or 1
end

function v_u_2.rainbowOf(p263) -- name: rainbowOf
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v264 = v_u_2.PETS[p263]
	if not v264 or (v264.variant ~= "Shiny" or not v264.base) then
		return nil
	end
	local v265 = v264.base .. v_u_2.SUFFIX.Rainbow
	return v_u_2.PETS[v265] and v265 and v265 or nil
end
function v_u_2.spare(p266, p267) -- name: spare
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	if p266:GetAttribute("PetLock_" .. p267) == true then
		return 0
	end
	local v268 = v_u_2.owned(p266, p267) - v_u_2.equipped(p266, p267)
	return math.max(v268, 0)
end
function v_u_2.isBig(p269) -- name: isBig
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v270 = v_u_2.PETS[p269]
	local v271
	if v270 == nil then
		v271 = false
	else
		v271 = v270.rarity == "Secret" and true or (v270.share or 0) >= 1
	end
	return v271
end
function v_u_2.percent(p272) -- name: percent
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	return v_u_2.percentRaw(p272):gsub("(%.%d-)0+%%$", "%1%%"):gsub("%.%%$", "%%")
end
function v_u_2.percentRaw(p273) -- name: percentRaw
	local v274 = p273 * 100
	if v274 >= 10 then
		return string.format("%.1f%%", v274)
	end
	if v274 >= 1 then
		return string.format("%.2f%%", v274)
	end
	if v274 >= 0.01 then
		return string.format("%.3f%%", v274)
	end
	if v274 <= 0 then
		return "0%"
	end
	local v275 = math.log10(v274)
	local v276 = 2 - math.floor(v275)
	local v277 = math.clamp(v276, 4, 12)
	return string.format("%." .. v277 .. "f%%", v274)
end

function v_u_2.stationMult(p278) -- name: stationMult
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v279 = v_u_2.PETS[p278]
	if not v279 then
		return 1
	end
	if not v279.share then
		return (v_u_2.STATIONS.MULT[v279.rarity] or 1.4) + (v_u_2.STATIONS.VARIANT[v279.variant or ""] or 0)

function v_u_10.viewport(p215, p216, p217, p218) -- name: viewport
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_11
	local v219 = v_u_10.new("ViewportFrame", {
		["BackgroundTransparency"] = 1,
		["Ambient"] = nil,
		["LightColor"] = nil,
		["LightDirection"] = Vector3.new(0.4, -1, 0.65),
		["Size"] = nil,
		["Ambient"] = v_u_11(165, 165, 178),
		["LightColor"] = v_u_11(255, 248, 236),
		["Size"] = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	}, p215)
	local v220 = p218 or {}
	for v221, v222 in pairs(p217 or {}) do
		v219[v221] = v222
	end
	local v223 = v_u_10.new("Camera", {
		["FieldOfView"] = 26
	}, v219)
	v219.CurrentCamera = v223
	local v_u_224 = p216:Clone()
	for _, v225 in ipairs(v_u_224:GetDescendants()) do
		if not (v225:IsA("Script") or (v225:IsA("LocalScript") or (v225:IsA("Sound") or v225:IsA("ParticleEmitter")))) then
			continue
		end
		v225:Destroy()
	end
	v_u_224:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	local v226, v227 = v_u_224:GetBoundingBox()
	local v_u_228 = v226.Position
	local v229 = v227.X
	local v230 = v227.Y
	local v231 = v227.Z
	local v232 = math.max(v229, v230, v231) / 2
	v_u_224.Parent = v219
	local v233 = (v220.dir or Vector3.new(0.5, 0.32, -1)).Unit
	local v234 = v223.FieldOfView / 2
	local v235 = math.rad(v234)
	local v236 = v232 / math.tan(v235) / (v220.fill or 0.92)
	v223.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(v_u_228 + v233 * v236, v_u_228)
	return {
		["vf"] = v219,
		["model"] = v_u_224,
		["cam"] = v223,
		["center"] = v_u_228,
		["r"] = v232,
		["pose"] = function(p237) -- name: pose
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_224
			v_u_224:PivotTo(p237)
		end,
		["turn"] = function(p238, p239, p240) -- name: turn
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_224, (copy) v_u_228
			v_u_224:PivotTo(CFrame.new(v_u_228) * CFrame.Angles(p239 or 0, p238 or 0, p240 or 0) * CFrame.new(-v_u_228))
		end
	}
end

function v_u_10.oddsOf(p262) -- name: oddsOf
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7
	for v263, v264 in pairs(v_u_7.EGGS) do
		for _, v265 in ipairs(v264.pets) do
			if v265.id ~= p262 then
				continue
			end
			for _, v266 in ipairs(v_u_7.chances(v263, 1)) do
				if v266.id ~= p262 then
					continue
				end
				return v266.odds, v263
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function v_u_10.powerNumber(p278) -- name: powerNumber
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_8
	local v279 = p278 * (v_u_7.POWER_SHOW or 100)
	if v279 >= 1000 then
		local v280 = v_u_8.Short
		local v281 = v279 + 0.5
		return v280((math.floor(v281)))
	else
		local v282 = v_u_8.Trim
		local v283 = v279 * 10 + 0.5
		return v282(math.floor(v283) / 10)
	end
end

function v_u_10.serials(p289, p290) -- name: serials
	local v291 = {}
	if p289 then
		p289 = p289:GetAttribute("PetSer_" .. p290)
	end
	if type(p289) == "string" then
		for v292 in p289:gmatch("%d+") do
			local v293 = tonumber(v292)
			table.insert(v291, v293)
		end
	end
	return v291
end
function v_u_10.serialText(p294, p295, p296) -- name: serialText
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10
	local v297 = v_u_10.serials(p294, p295)
	if #v297 == 0 then
		return ""
	end
	local v298 = #v297
	local v299 = {}
	for v300 = 1, math.min(v298, p296 or 2) do
		v299[v300] = "#" .. v_u_10.short(v297[v300])
	end
	local v301 = table.concat(v299, ", ")
	if (p296 or 2) < #v297 then
		v301 = v301 .. " +" .. #v297 - (p296 or 2)
	end
	return v301
end

	for v44 = 2, #p42 do

	end
end

function v_u_1.Format(p114) -- name: Format
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_110
	local v115 = tonumber(p114) or 0
	local v116 = (v115 ~= v115 or v115 == (-1 / 0)) and "0" or (v115 == (1 / 0) and "MAX" or nil)
	if v116 then
		return v116
	end
	local v117 = v115 + 0.5
	local v118 = math.floor(v117)
	if v118 < 1000 then
		return tostring(v118)
	end
	local v119 = math.log10(v118) / 3
	local v120 = math.floor(v119)
	local v121 = #v_u_110 - 1
	local v122 = math.min(v120, v121)
	local v123 = v118 / 10 ^ (v122 * 3)
	return (v123 >= 100 and string.format("%.0f", v123) or (v123 >= 10 and string.format("%.1f", v123) or string.format("%.2f", v123))) .. v_u_110[v122 + 1]
end
function v_u_1.Compact(p124) -- name: Compact
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_110
	local v125 = tonumber(p124) or 0
	local v126 = math.max(v125, 0)
	local v127 = (v126 ~= v126 or v126 == (-1 / 0)) and "0" or (v126 == (1 / 0) and "MAX" or nil)
	if v127 then
		return v127
	end
	if v126 < 1000 then
		local v128 = v126 + 0.5
		local v129 = math.floor(v128)
		return tostring(v129)
	end
	local v130 = math.log10(v126) / 3
	local v131 = math.floor(v130)
	local v132 = #v_u_110 - 1
	local v133 = math.min(v131, v132)
	local v134 = v126 / 10 ^ (v133 * 3) * 10
	local v135 = math.floor(v134) / 10
	return string.format("%.1f", v135):gsub("%.0$", "") .. v_u_110[v133 + 1]
end

function v_u_1.UpgradeCost(p137, p138) -- name: UpgradeCost
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v139 = v_u_1.Upgrades[p137]
	if v139.currency == "Eggs" then
		local v140 = v139.baseCost * v139.growth ^ p138 + 0.5
		return math.floor(v140)
	end
	local v141 = v139.baseCost * v139.growth ^ p138
	if v139.lateFrom and v139.lateFrom <= p138 then
		v141 = v141 * (v139.lateGrowth or 1) ^ (p138 - v139.lateFrom + 1)
	end
	local v142 = math.log10(v141)
	local v143 = 10 ^ (math.floor(v142) - 1)
	local v144 = v141 / v143 + 0.5
	local v145 = math.floor(v144) * v143
	if v139.currency == "Grubs" or (v139.currency == "Worms" or v139.currency == "Coal") then
		local v146 = v145 - 1e-9
		v145 = math.ceil(v146)
	end
	return v145
end

	return 3 ^ (p206:GetAttribute("Up_SwordTier") or 0) * (p206:GetAttribute("TreeSword") or 1) * (p206:GetAttribute("MerchSword") or 1)
end
function v_u_1.SwingTime(p207) -- name: SwingTime
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	return v_u_1.Brawl.SWING * (p207:GetAttribute("TreeSwing") or 1)
end
function v_u_1.DoubloonRate(p208) -- name: DoubloonRate
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v209 = v_u_1.PirateKind(p208)
	local v210 = v_u_1.Brawl.PIRATES[v209].hp
	local v211 = v_u_1.SwordDamage(p208)
	local v212 = v210 / math.max(v211, 1e-9)
	local v213 = 1 / (math.ceil(v212) * v_u_1.SwingTime(p208) + 1.2)
	local v214 = v_u_1.PirateCount(p208) / v_u_1.Brawl.RESPAWN
	local v215 = math.min(v213, v214)
	if v_u_1.SpecialOn(p208, "AutoPlunder") then
		v215 = v215 + 0.3333333333333333
	end
	return v215 * v_u_1.DoubloonsPerKill(p208, v209) * v_u_1.GoldenAverage()
end
function v_u_1.DoubloonsPerKill(p216, p217) -- name: DoubloonsPerKill
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	return (v_u_1.Brawl.PIRATES[p217 or 1] or v_u_1.Brawl.PIRATES[1]).reward * v_u_1.BountyMult(p216:GetAttribute("Up_Bounty")) * (p216:GetAttribute("TreeDoubloons") or 1) * (p216:GetAttribute("FossilDoubloons") or 1) * (p216:GetAttribute("TitleDoubloons") or 1) * (p216:GetAttribute("MerchDoubloons") or 1) * (p216:GetAttribute("EchoDoubloons") or 1) * (p216:GetAttribute("ShopDoubloons") or 1) * v_u_1.RebirthBonus(p216:GetAttribute("Rebirths"), "doubloons")
end

function v_u_1.FishFound(p227) -- name: FishFound
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v228 = 0
	for v229 in ipairs(v_u_1.Fish.list) do
		if p227:GetAttribute(v_u_1.FishKey(v229)) == true then
			v228 = v228 + 1
		end
		if p227:GetAttribute(v_u_1.GoldKey(v229)) ~= true then
			continue
		end
		v228 = v228 + 1
	end
	return v228
end

function v_u_1.FishLuckTotal(p231) -- name: FishLuckTotal
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	return v_u_1.FishLuckMult(p231:GetAttribute("Up_FishLuck") or 0) * v_u_1.FishIndexLuck(v_u_1.FishFound(p231)) * (p231:GetAttribute("TreeFishLuck") or 1) * (p231:GetAttribute("MerchFishLuck") or 1) * v_u_1.FishLuck2Mult(p231:GetAttribute("Up_FishLuck2") or 0) * ((p231:GetAttribute("PearlLevel") or 0) >= 2 and 2 or 1) * (p231:GetAttribute("MilestoneFishLuck") or 1) * (p231:GetAttribute("ShopFishLuck") or 1)
end

	local v233 = p232:GetAttribute("Setting_FishLuck")
	return type(v233) == "number" and (v233 == v233 and math.clamp(v233, 0, 1)) or 1
end
function v_u_1.FishLuckAt(p234, p235) -- name: FishLuckAt
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v236 = v_u_1.FishLuckTotal(p234)
	return math.max(v236, 1) ^ math.clamp(p235, 0, 1)
end

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	return (p238:GetAttribute("Room_FishingDock") == true or (p238:GetAttribute("PearlLevel") or 0) > 0) and true or v_u_1.FishFound(p238) > 0
end
function v_u_1.RollFish(p239, p240) -- name: RollFish
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v241 = v_u_1.Fish.list
	for v242 = #v241, 2, -1 do
		if p240:NextNumber() >= p239 / v241[v242].odds then
			continue
		end
		return v242
	end
	return 1
end

end
function v_u_1.IncomePerSecond(p316, p317, p318, p319, p320) -- name: IncomePerSecond
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	return v_u_1.CashPerTick(p316, p317, p319, p320) / v_u_1.TickInterval(p318)
end

function v_u_1.FossilSetKept(p432, p433) -- name: FossilSetKept
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	if p432:GetAttribute("Special_Keep" .. p433 .. "Fossils") then
		return true
	end
	for v434, v435 in pairs(v_u_1.SpecialKeepFossilSets) do
		if not (p432:GetAttribute("Special_" .. v434) and table.find(v435, p433)) then
			continue
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end
function v_u_1.TreeNodeLayer(p436) -- name: TreeNodeLayer
	return p436.tree == 6 and ((p436.rebirth or 0) >= 8 and "Pirate" or "Underworld") or (p436.tree == 5 and "Void" or (p436.tree == 4 and "Fungal" or (p436.tree == 3 and ((p436.rebirth or 0) >= 4 and "Frost" or "Lake") or (p436.tree == 2 and "Spider" or ((p436.rebirth or 0) >= 1 and "Stone" or "Dirt")))))
end

end

for v444, v445 in pairs(v_u_1.MerchantRarity) do
	local v446 = table.clone(v445)
	local v447 = v445.cost * v443
	local v448 = math.log10(v447)
	local v449 = 10 ^ (math.floor(v448) - 1)
	local v450 = v447 / v449 + 0.5
	v446.cost = math.floor(v450) * v449
	v_u_1.PirateMerchantRarity[v444] = v446
end

v_u_1.MerchantById = {}
for v451, v452 in ipairs(v_u_1.MerchantList) do
	v452.index = v451
	v_u_1.MerchantById[v452.id] = v452
end
for v453, v454 in ipairs(v_u_1.IceMerchantList) do
	v454.index = v453
	v454.shop = "Ice"
	v_u_1.MerchantById[v454.id] = v454
end
for v455, v456 in ipairs(v_u_1.PirateMerchantList) do
	v456.index = v455
	v456.shop = "Pirate"
	v_u_1.MerchantById[v456.id] = v456
end
function v_u_1.MerchantShop(p457) -- name: MerchantShop
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	if p457 and p457.shop == "Ice" then
		return v_u_1.IceMerchant, v_u_1.IceMerchantRarity, v_u_1.IceMerchantList
	elseif p457 and p457.shop == "Pirate" then
		return v_u_1.PirateMerchant, v_u_1.PirateMerchantRarity, v_u_1.PirateMerchantList
	else
		return v_u_1.Merchant, v_u_1.MerchantRarity, v_u_1.MerchantList
	end
end

	["Slots"] = true

function v_u_1.MerchantCost(p458, p459) -- name: MerchantCost
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v460 = v_u_1.MerchantById[p458]
	local v461, v462 = v_u_1.MerchantShop(v460)
	local v463 = v462[v460.rarity].cost * v461.COST_GROWTH ^ p459
	local v464 = math.log10(v463)
	local v465 = 10 ^ (math.floor(v464) - 1)
	local v466 = v463 / v465 + 0.5
	return math.floor(v466) * v465
end
function v_u_1.MerchantTotals(p467) -- name: MerchantTotals
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v468 = {}
	local v469 = {}
	for _, v470 in ipairs({ v_u_1.IceMerchantList, v_u_1.PirateMerchantList }) do
		local v471 = {}
		for _, v472 in ipairs(v470) do
			local v473 = p467(v472.id) or 0
			local v474 = v472.max
			local v475 = math.min(v473, v474)
			for v476, v477 in pairs(v472.fx) do
				if v477[1] ~= "mul" then
					continue
				end
				v471[v476] = (v471[v476] or 0) + v477[2] * v475
			end
		end
		table.insert(v468, v471)
	end
	local v478 = table.clone(v_u_1.MerchantList)
	for _, v479 in ipairs(v_u_1.IceMerchantList) do
		table.insert(v478, v479)
	end
	for _, v480 in ipairs(v_u_1.PirateMerchantList) do
		table.insert(v478, v480)
	end
	for _, v481 in ipairs(v478) do
		local v482 = p467(v481.id) or 0
		local v483 = v481.max
		local v484 = math.min(v482, v483)
		if v481.shop then
			for v485, v486 in pairs(v481.fx) do
				if v486[1] ~= "add" then
					continue
				end
				v469[v485] = (v469[v485] or 0) + v486[2] * v484
			end
		else
			for v487, v488 in pairs(v481.fx) do
				local v489 = v_u_1.MerchantAdds[v487]
				local v490 = v469[v487] or (v489 and 0 or 1)
				if v488[1] == "add" then
					v490 = v490 + v488[2] * v484
				elseif v488[1] == "mul" then
					v490 = v490 * (1 + v488[2] * v484)
				elseif v488[1] == "step" then
					if v484 > 0 then
						v490 = v490 * (v488[2] * v484)
					end
				else
					v490 = v490 * v488[2] ^ v484
				end
				v469[v487] = v490
			end
		end
	end
	for _, v491 in ipairs(v468) do
		for v492, v493 in pairs(v491) do
			local v494 = v469[v492] or 1
			local v495 = 1 + v493
			v469[v492] = v494 * math.max(v495, 0.05)
		end
	end
	return v469
end

local function v521(p502, p503, p504, p505, p506, p507, p508, p509) -- name: fossilSet
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_498, (copy) v_u_496, (copy) v_u_497, (copy) v_u_1
	local v510 = {}
	for v511 = 1, 10 do
		local v512 = {}
		for v513, v514 in pairs((p509 or v_u_498)[v511]) do
			local v515 = v513 == "Cash" and p505.cash or v513 == "Luck" and p505.luck or (v513 == "Grubs" and p505.grubs or v513 == "Fish" and p505.fish) or (v513 == "Spores" and p505.spores or v513 == "Essence" and p505.essence or (v513 == "Souls" and p505.souls or v513 == "Doubloons" and p505.doubloons))
			if not v515 then
				if v513 == "Worms" or v513 == "Coal" then
					v515 = p505.side
				else
					v515 = false
				end
			end
			if not v515 then
				continue
			end
			v512[v513] = v515 * v514 / p508[v511]
		end
		v510[v511] = {
			["name"] = p506[v511],
			["rarity"] = v_u_496[v511],
			["odds"] = p507[v511],
			["buffs"] = v512,
			["max"] = p508[v511],
			["color"] = v_u_497[v511]
		}
	end
	local v516 = v_u_1.DeepCashPrice(p504) * 0.0006
	local v517 = math.log10(v516)
	local v518 = 10 ^ (math.floor(v517) - 1)
	local v519 = {
		["title"] = p502,
		["room"] = p503
	}
	local v520 = v516 / v518 + 0.5
	v519.cost = math.floor(v520) * v518
	v519.list = v510
	return v519
end

function v_u_1.Commas(p522) -- name: Commas
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	if p522 ~= p522 or p522 == (1 / 0) then
		return v_u_1.Format(p522)
	end
	if p522 < 100 then
		return v_u_1.Trim(p522)
	end
	if p522 >= 1000000000000000 then
		return v_u_1.Format(p522)
	end
	local v523 = p522 + 0.5
	local v524 = math.floor(v523)
	local v525 = tostring(v524)
	repeat
		local v526
		v525, v526 = v525:gsub("^(%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
	until v526 == 0
	return v525
end

function v_u_1.FossilTotals(p528, p529) -- name: FossilTotals
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v530 = 0
	local v531 = {
		["Cash"] = 1,
		["Luck"] = 1,
		["Worms"] = 1,
		["Coal"] = 1,
		["Grubs"] = 1,
		["Fish"] = 1,
		["Spores"] = 1,
		["Essence"] = 1,
		["Souls"] = 1,
		["Doubloons"] = 1
	}
	for v532, v533 in pairs(v_u_1.Fossils) do
		for v534, v535 in ipairs(v533.list) do
			local v536 = p528(v532, v534) or 0
			local v537 = v535.max
			local v538 = math.min(v536, v537)
			v530 = v530 + v538
			local v539 = p529 and p529(v532, v534) and (v_u_1.SHINY_MULT or 1) or 1
			for v540, v541 in pairs(v_u_1.FossilBuffs(v535)) do
				v531[v540] = (v531[v540] or 1) + v538 * v541 * v539
			end
		end
	end
	return v531, v530
end

v_u_1.SHINY_COMMON = 100

	return "Shiny_" .. p544 .. "_" .. p545

function v_u_1.ShinyCount(p547) -- name: ShinyCount
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v548 = 0
	for v549, v550 in pairs(v_u_1.Fossils) do
		for v551 in ipairs(v550.list) do
			if p547:GetAttribute(v_u_1.ShinyKey(v549, v551)) ~= true then
				continue
			end
			v548 = v548 + 1
		end
	end
	return v548
end
function v_u_1.ShinyLuck(p552) -- name: ShinyLuck
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	return 1 + v_u_1.SHINY_INDEX_LUCK * (p552 or 0)
end
function v_u_1.ShinyBoost(p553) -- name: ShinyBoost
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	return p553:GetAttribute("Special_ShinyFossils") ~= true and 0 or v_u_1.ShinyLuck(v_u_1.ShinyCount(p553)) * (p553:GetAttribute("MilestoneShiny") or 1) * (p553:GetAttribute("TitleShiny") or 1) * (p553:GetAttribute("TreeShiny") or 1)
end
local v_u_554 = {}
function v_u_1.ShinyOdds(p555, p556) -- name: ShinyOdds
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_554, (copy) v_u_1
	local v557 = p555 .. "_" .. p556
	local v558 = v_u_554[v557]
	if not v558 then
		local v559 = (table.find(v_u_1.FossilSetOrder, p555) or 1) - 1
		local v560 = #v_u_1.Fossils[p555].list
		local v561 = v_u_1.SHINY_COMMON * v_u_1.SHINY_COMMON_GROW ^ v559
		local v562 = v_u_1.SHINY_RAREST * v_u_1.SHINY_RAREST_GROW ^ v559 / v561
		local v563 = p556 - 1
		local v564 = v560 - 1
		local v565 = v561 * v562 ^ (v563 / math.max(v564, 1)) ^ v_u_1.SHINY_CURVE + 0.5
		v558 = math.floor(v565)
		v_u_554[v557] = v558
	end
	return v558 * v_u_1.SHINY_SCALE
end
function v_u_1.ShinyChance(p566, p567, p568) -- name: ShinyChance
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	return v_u_1.ShinyBoost(p566) / v_u_1.ShinyOdds(p567, p568)
end
v_u_1.SHINY_COLORS = {
	{ 255, 170, 200 },
	{ 255, 226, 150 },
	{ 170, 240, 180 },
	{ 150, 210, 255 },
	{ 210, 170, 255 }
}
function v_u_1.ShinyGradient() -- name: ShinyGradient
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v569 = #v_u_1.SHINY_COLORS
	local v570 = {}
	for v571 = 0, v569 do
		local v572 = v_u_1.SHINY_COLORS[v571 % v569 + 1]
		local v573 = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new
		local v574 = v571 / v569
		local v575 = Color3.fromRGB
		local v576 = v572[1]
		local v577 = v572[2]
		local v578 = v572[3]
		table.insert(v570, v573(v574, v575(v576, v577, v578)))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(v570)
end
function v_u_1.Short(p579) -- name: Short
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1

function v_u_1.RollFossil(p580, p581, p582, p583) -- name: RollFossil
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v584 = v_u_1.Fossils[p580].list
	local v585 = 1
	for v586 = #v584, 2, -1 do
		if p582:NextNumber() >= p581 / v584[v586].odds then
			continue
		end
		v585 = v586
	end
	if p583 then
		for v587 = v585, 1, -1 do
			if p583(v587) then
				continue
			end
			return v587, v585
		end
	end
	return v585, v585
end
function v_u_1.Hype(p588, p589) -- name: Hype
	local v590 = (p588 or 1) / math.max(p589 or 1, 1)
	local v591 = math.max(v590, 1)
	local v592 = (math.log10(v591) - 2) / 4
	return math.clamp(v592, 0, 1)
end

function v_u_1.TitleSetOf(p608) -- name: TitleSetOf
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	for _, v609 in ipairs(v_u_1.TitleSetOrder) do
		local v610 = v_u_1.TitleSets[v609]
		if v610.first > p608 or p608 > v610.last then
			continue

	end
end

function v_u_1.TitleBuff(p611, p612) -- name: TitleBuff
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1

end

function v_u_1.TitleIndexLuck(p614) -- name: TitleIndexLuck
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	return 1 + v_u_1.TITLE_INDEX_LUCK * (p614 or 0)
end
function v_u_1.TitlesFound(p615) -- name: TitlesFound
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v616 = 0
	for v617 in ipairs(v_u_1.Titles) do
		if not p615(v617) then
			continue
		end
		v616 = v616 + 1
	end
	return v616
end
function v_u_1.FullTitleLuck(p_u_618) -- name: FullTitleLuck
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v620 = v_u_1.TitlesFound(function(p619)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_618
		return (p_u_618:GetAttribute("Title_" .. p619) or 0) > 0
	end)
	return v_u_1.TitleLuck(p_u_618:GetAttribute("Up_TitleLuck") or 0) * (p_u_618:GetAttribute("MerchTitleLuck") or 1) * (p_u_618:GetAttribute("MilestoneTitleLuck") or 1) * (p_u_618:GetAttribute("ShopTitleLuck") or 1) * (p_u_618:GetAttribute("TreeTitleLuck") or 1) * v_u_1.TitleIndexLuck(v620) * v_u_1.RebirthBonus(p_u_618:GetAttribute("Rebirths") or 0, "titleLuck") * v_u_1.IceTitleLuck(p_u_618:GetAttribute("Up_IceTitleLuck") or 0) * ((p_u_618:GetAttribute("PearlLevel") or 0) >= 5 and 2 or 1)
end
function v_u_1.TitleLuckShare(p621) -- name: TitleLuckShare
	local v622 = p621:GetAttribute("Setting_TitleLuck")
	return type(v622) == "number" and (v622 == v622 and math.clamp(v622, 0, 1)) or 1
end
function v_u_1.TitleLuckAt(p623, p624) -- name: TitleLuckAt
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v625 = v_u_1.FullTitleLuck(p623)
	return math.max(v625, 1) ^ math.clamp(p624, 0, 1)
end
function v_u_1.LuckText(p626) -- name: LuckText
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	if p626 < 100 then
		local v627 = v_u_1.Trim
		local v628 = p626 * 100 + 0.5
		return "x" .. v627(math.floor(v628) / 100)
	else
		if p626 >= 1000 then
			return "x" .. v_u_1.Short(p626)
		end
		local v629 = p626 + 0.5
		return "x" .. math.floor(v629)
	end
end
function v_u_1.ChosenTitleLuck(p630) -- name: ChosenTitleLuck
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	return v_u_1.TitleLuckAt(p630, v_u_1.TitleLuckShare(p630))
end
function v_u_1.TitleLuckUnlocked(p631) -- name: TitleLuckUnlocked
	return (p631:GetAttribute("Room_Titles") == true or p631:GetAttribute("Room_Titles2") == true) and true or (p631:GetAttribute("TitlesRolled") or 0) > 0
end
function v_u_1.TitleTag(p632) -- name: TitleTag
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v633 = v_u_1.Titles[p632]
	return not v633 and "" or "[" .. v633.name .. (v633.odds > 1 and " 1/" .. v_u_1.Short(v633.odds) or "") .. "]"
end
function v_u_1.RollTitle(p634, p635, p636) -- name: RollTitle
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v637 = v_u_1.TitleSets[p636 or "Dirt"] or v_u_1.TitleSets.Dirt
	for v638 = v637.last, v637.first + 1, -1 do
		if p635:NextNumber() >= p634 / v_u_1.Titles[v638].odds then
			continue
		end
		return v638
	end
	return v637.first
end

function v_u_1.RebirthsForStep(p1038) -- name: RebirthsForStep
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v1039 = 0
	for _, v1040 in ipairs(v_u_1.StepGates) do
		if v1040.step > p1038 then

	end
	return v1039
end
function v_u_1.BossForStep(p1042) -- name: BossForStep
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	for _, v1043 in ipairs(v_u_1.StepGates) do
		if p1042 ~= v1043.step or not v1043.boss then
			continue
		end
		return v_u_1.Boss[v1043.boss]
	end
	return nil
end
function v_u_1.StepBlocked(p1044, p1045) -- name: StepBlocked
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v1046 = v_u_1.RebirthsForStep(p1045)
	if (p1044:GetAttribute("Rebirths") or 0) < v1046 then
		return "Needs Rebirth " .. v1046
	else
		local v1047 = v_u_1.BossForStep(p1045)
		if v1047 and p1044:GetAttribute(v1047.key) ~= true then
			return "Defeat the " .. v1047.name:lower():gsub("^the%s+", ""):gsub("%f[%a]%a", string.upper)
		else
			return nil
		end
	end
end

function v_u_1.EchoRoll(p1243, p1244, p1245) -- name: EchoRoll
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v1246 = v_u_1.EchoById[p1243]
	local v1247 = v1246.pool[p1244:NextInteger(1, #v1246.pool)]
	local v1248 = 0
	for _, v1249 in ipairs(v_u_1.Echo.QUALITIES) do
		v1248 = v1248 + v1249.weight * (v1249.index >= 3 and (p1245 or 1) or 1)
	end
	local v1250 = p1244:NextNumber() * v1248
	local v1251 = v_u_1.Echo.QUALITIES[1]
	for _, v1252 in ipairs(v_u_1.Echo.QUALITIES) do
		v1250 = v1250 - v1252.weight * (v1252.index >= 3 and (p1245 or 1) or 1)
		if v1250 > 0 then
			continue
		end
		v1251 = v1252
	end
	local v1253 = v1251.range[1] + (v1251.range[2] - v1251.range[1]) * p1244:NextNumber()
	local v1254 = v1247[2] + (v1247[3] - v1247[2]) * v1253
	local v1255 = {
		["stat"] = v1247[1],
		["quality"] = v1251.name
	}
	local v1256 = v1254 * 1000 + 0.5
	v1255.value = math.floor(v1256) / 1000
	return v1255
end
function v_u_1.EchoEncode(p1257) -- name: EchoEncode
	local v1258 = p1257.stat
	local v1259 = p1257.quality
	local v1260 = p1257.value
	return v1258 .. "|" .. v1259 .. "|" .. tostring(v1260)
end
function v_u_1.EchoDecode(p1261) -- name: EchoDecode
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	if type(p1261) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local v1262, v1263, v1264 = p1261:match("^(%w+)|(%w+)|([%d%.%-e]+)$")
	return v1262 and v_u_1.Echo.STATS[v1262] and {
		["stat"] = v1262,
		["quality"] = v1263,
		["value"] = tonumber(v1264) or 1
	} or nil
end
function v_u_1.EchoText(p1265) -- name: EchoText
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v1266 = v_u_1.Echo.STATS[p1265.stat]
	if v1266 then
		if v1266.kind == "faster" then
			local v1267 = (1 - p1265.value) * 100 + 0.5
			return math.floor(v1267) .. "% " .. v1266.label
		elseif v1266.kind == "add" then
			local v1268 = v_u_1.Trim
			local v1269 = p1265.value * 10 + 0.5
			return "+" .. v1268(math.floor(v1269) / 10) .. " " .. v1266.label
		else
			local v1270 = v_u_1.Trim
			local v1271 = p1265.value * 100 + 0.5
			return "x" .. v1270(math.floor(v1271) / 100) .. " " .. v1266.label
		end
	else
		return "?"
	end
end
function v_u_1.EchoHP(p1272, p1273) -- name: EchoHP
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v1274 = (p1273 or 0) * p1272.time / p1272.swing * (p1272.echoShare or v_u_1.Echo.HP_SHARE) * (v_u_1.Echo.EASE or 1)
	return math.max(v1274, 1)
end
function v_u_1.EchoWait(p1275, p1276) -- name: EchoWait
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v1277 = (p1275:GetAttribute("EchoCD_" .. p1276) or 0) + v_u_1.Echo.COOLDOWN * (p1275:GetAttribute("MilestoneEchoCD") or 1) - os.time()
	return math.max(0, v1277)
end
function v_u_1.EchoBeaten(p1278, p1279) -- name: EchoBeaten
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v1280 = v_u_1.Boss[p1279]
	local v1281
	if v1280 == nil then
		v1281 = false
	else
		v1281 = p1278:GetAttribute(v1280.gate) == true and true or p1278:GetAttribute(v1280.key) == true
	end
	return v1281
end

function v_u_1.MilestoneAmount(p1282, p1283) -- name: MilestoneAmount
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v1284 = v_u_1.MilestoneStats[p1282].kind
	if v1284 == "pct" then
		return "+" .. v_u_1.Trim(p1283 * 100) .. "%"
	elseif v1284 == "secs" then
		return "+" .. v_u_1.Trim(p1283) .. "s"
	elseif v1284 == "mult" then
		return "x" .. v_u_1.Trim(p1283)
	elseif v1284 == "size" then
		return tostring(p1283)
	else
		return "+" .. v_u_1.Trim(p1283)
	end
end

local v_u_1944 = v_u_1.MerchantTotals
function v_u_1.MerchantTotals(p_u_1945) -- name: MerchantTotals
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1944, (copy) v_u_1
	local v1948 = v_u_1944(function(p1946)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (copy) p_u_1945
		local v1947 = v_u_1.MerchantById[p1946]
		return v1947 and v1947.shop == "Core" and 0 or p_u_1945(p1946)
	end)
	local v1949 = {}
	for _, v1950 in ipairs(v_u_1.CoreMerchantList) do
		local v1951 = p_u_1945(v1950.id) or 0
		local v1952 = v1950.max
		local v1953 = math.min(v1951, v1952)
		for v1954, v1955 in pairs(v1950.fx) do
			if v1955[1] ~= "mul" then
				continue
			end
			v1949[v1954] = (v1949[v1954] or 0) + v1955[2] * v1953
		end
	end
	for v1956, v1957 in pairs(v1949) do
		local v1958 = v1948[v1956] or 1
		local v1959 = 1 + v1957
		v1948[v1956] = v1958 * math.max(v1959, 0.05)
	end
	return v1948
end

function v_u_1.MaxTitleLuck() -- name: MaxTitleLuck
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1960, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_1965
	if v_u_1960.title then
		return v_u_1960.title
	end
	local v1966 = 0
	for _, v1967 in ipairs(v_u_1.Titles) do
		if not v1967.odds then
			continue
		end
		v1966 = v1966 + 1
	end
	local v1972 = v_u_1.TitleLuck(v_u_1.Upgrades.TitleLuck.max) * v_u_1.IceTitleLuck(v_u_1.Upgrades.IceTitleLuck.max) * (v_u_1965().TitleLuck or 1) * v_u_1.MilestoneBonuses(function(p1968)
		return #p1968.goals

		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
		local v1970 = v_u_1.TreeById[p1969]
		local v1971

			v1971 = false

			v1971 = not v1970.soon

	end).TreeTitleLuck or 1) * v_u_1.TitleIndexLuck(v1966) * v_u_1.RebirthBonus(#v_u_1.Rebirths, "titleLuck") * 2 * v_u_1.RiteBonuses(v_u_1.Rite.MAX).titleLuck

end

function v_u_1.MagmaRate(p1978) -- name: MagmaRate
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v1979 = 0
	for v1980, v1981 in ipairs(v_u_1.Mine.TIERS) do
		if not v_u_1.MineTierOpen(p1978, v1980) or p1978:GetAttribute("Room_" .. v1981.room) ~= true then
			continue
		end
		local v1982 = v1981.hp
		local v1983 = v_u_1.PickaxeDamage(p1978)
		local v1984 = v1982 / math.max(v1983, 1e-9)
		local v1985 = math.ceil(v1984)
		local v1986 = v_u_1.MagmaPerVein(p1978, v1980) / (v1985 * v_u_1.MineSwingTime(p1978) + 0.6)
		v1979 = math.max(v1979, v1986)
	end
	return math.max(v1979, 1)
end
function v_u_1.IngotRate(p1987) -- name: IngotRate
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v1988 = v_u_1.FurnaceCapacity(p1987) / v_u_1.SmeltTime(p1987)
	local v1989 = v_u_1.MagmaRate(p1987) * v_u_1.VeinCount(p1987)
	local v1990 = math.min(v1988, v1989)
	local v1991 = v_u_1.IngotsFor(p1987, v1990)
	return math.max(v1991, 1)
end

function v_u_1.W2Round(p2031) -- name: w2round
	if p2031 < 100 then
		local v2032 = p2031 + 0.5
		return math.floor(v2032)
	end
	local v2033 = math.log10(p2031)
	local v2034 = 10 ^ (math.floor(v2033) - 1)
	local v2035 = p2031 / v2034 + 0.5
	return math.floor(v2035) * v2034
end

function v_u_1.UpgradeText(p2255, p2256) -- name: UpgradeText
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2254
	if p2255 == "WoodPerHit" then
		return "+" .. 1 + p2256
	end
	if p2255 == "ChopSpeed" then
		local v2257 = v_u_1.Lumber.HIT_TIME - v_u_1.Lumber.HIT_STEP * p2256
		local v2258 = math.max(0.4, v2257)
		return string.format("%.2f", v2258):gsub("%.?0+$", "") .. "s"
	end

		return "+" .. v_u_1.Apiary.BASE + v_u_1.Apiary.PER_LEVEL * p2256
	end
	if p2255 == "MarbleCount" then
		local v2259 = 1 + p2256
		return tostring(v2259)
	end
	if p2255 == "MarbleValue" then
		return "+" .. v_u_1.Plinko.BASE + v_u_1.Plinko.PER_LEVEL * p2256
	end
	if p2255 ~= "WoodBucks" and (p2255 ~= "HoneyWood" and (p2255 ~= "HoneyBucks" and p2255 ~= "MarbleBucks")) then
		return v_u_2254(p2255, p2256)
	end
	local v2260 = 1.2 ^ p2256
	return "x" .. (v2260 < 1000 and string.format("%.2f", v2260):gsub("%.?0+$", "") or v_u_1.Short(v2260))
end

					continue

function v_u_416.Enchanting()

		if v463 > v_u_4.EnchantSlots(v_u_6) then
			continue
		end
		local v464, v465 = v_u_4.EnchantIn(v_u_6, v463)
		if not v464 then
			continue
		end
		v462 = v462 + v465
	end
	local v466 = v_u_4.EnchantSlots(v_u_6)
	local v467 = v_u_4.Enchant.SLOT_COST[v466 + 1]
	local v468
	if v467 == nil then
		v468 = false
	else
		v468 = v467 <= (v_u_6:GetAttribute("Embers") or 0)
	end
	return v468, v462 / (#v_u_4.Enchant.NAMES * 3)
end

local function v_u_85(p49, p50) -- name: solveArm
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_31, (ref) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_8
	local v51 = v_u_31[p49]
	local v52 = v_u_36.arm[p49]
	local v53 = p50:PointToObjectSpace(v52.pos) - v51.S0
	local v54 = v53.Magnitude
	local v55 = v51.l1 - v51.l2
	local v56 = math.abs(v55) + 1
	local v57 = v51.l1 + v51.l2 - 0.5
	local v58 = math.clamp(v54, v56, v57)
	local v59 = v53.Unit
	local v60 = (v51.l1 * v51.l1 + v58 * v58 - v51.l2 * v51.l2) / (2 * v51.l1 * v58)

	local v63 = v62 - v59 * v62:Dot(v59)

	local v67 = 1 - v61 * v61
